description: Join the waitlist for a fully-booked event type. When a slot opens up (via cancellation), the invitee is automatically promoted to a confirmed booking and notified. Use this when check_availability shows no available slots but the event type has waitlist enabled. Optionally specify a preferred time slot.

duration_minutes.description: Preferred duration in minutes for variable-duration event types.

event_type_id.description: ID of the event type to join the waitlist for. Optional if ASTROCAL_DEFAULT_EVENT_TYPE_ID is set.

invitee_email.description: Email address of the invitee (will receive notifications)

invitee_name.description: Full name of the person joining the waitlist

invitee_timezone.description: IANA timezone of the invitee (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles'). Defaults to UTC.

start_time.description: Preferred time slot (ISO 8601 datetime). If omitted, the invitee will be promoted to any slot that opens up.

name: join_waitlist
